_comment: Run template for at-30bldg-sensors (research-only, CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0: every report built from it carries the non-commercial / do-not-redistribute banner). One building per facility (`camber datasets config at-30bldg-sensors --facility ds-at-30bldg-sensors-b02` picks one; default: the first ingested), one equipment per anonymised sensor. No fault rule runs: every rule needs several points of one piece of equipment, a fan status, an occupancy schedule or setpoints, and this dataset has none of them (no topology, anonymised ids). The supply-air and chilled-water reset rules would also judge European ventilation units supplying near-neutral air against US VAV sequences. Use the RCx report's sensor-health section (range violations, flatlines, gaps and trust per sensor) -- that is what this dataset teaches.
